tree.title: The run never started
tree.desc: No crawl or scan job appears at the scheduled time, or the property shows no new run.

children.title: Scheduler refused to create the run
children.desc: admin/front log 'failed to create entity for property' with a reason in error.message.

children.title: Licence expired or limit reached
children.pattern: failed to create entity … + error.type LimitExceededException ('The license has expired')
children.next: Check the tenant licence / limit.running-scans-count in Retool.

children.title: Property setup incomplete
children.pattern: failed to create entity … + 'No URLs were supplied' / 'URL set not defined' / 'runner wait < 30s'
children.next: Fix the property settings (seed list, runner wait).

children.title: Schedule points at a deleted property
children.pattern: failed to create entity … + 'property not found'
children.next: Clean up the orphan schedule; usually harmless.

children.title: Schedule stuck or skipped
children.desc: The next-run time is in the past or repeats; a duplicate-job error repeats every ~7.5 min.

children.title: Same past slot keeps colliding
children.pattern: duplicate key … key_type_constraint … JobEntity already exists — with a run time in the past, repeating
children.next: Current-slot duplicates are a harmless race between two schedulers; a past slot that repeats = stuck schedule.

children.title: Next run time looks wrong
children.pattern: for property: <id>, the next schedule job time is: <time> — compare with the UI schedule
children.next: No time zone in the line: compare with the property's configured time zone.

children.title: Crawl request never reached the crawler
children.desc: admin/front 'Failed running create crawl request'; scrape-server DB pool errors.

children.title: Dispatch refused or timed out
children.pattern: Failed running create crawl request for URL set … (+ scrape-server HikariPool Connection is not available)
children.next: Evinced-side. Re-run; escalate if several properties are affected.

tree.title: The run started but the job died
tree.desc: The job moved to FAILED, or stayed RUNNING until a timeout.

children.title: Many customers failing at the same time
children.desc: Distinct tenants with errors per hour jumps far above the 0–5 baseline; worker log volume drops.

children.title: Platform incident
children.pattern: aggregate: distinct tenants with ERROR per hour (chronic noise excluded); scan-worker volume drop
children.next: Check status channel; tell the customer it is Evinced-side and re-run after the fix.

children.title: Job failed on Evinced infrastructure
children.desc: Kubernetes job failure, job marked FAILED by the poller, or upload errors.

children.title: Worker pod failed
children.pattern: kubernetes job failed … reason=BackoffLimitExceeded (name = scanId)
children.next: Often out-of-memory on huge sites; check page count / heavy pages (D1).

children.title: Job timed out and was marked FAILED
children.pattern: Sampling scan with ID=… passed its timeout, marking it as FAILED / job … changed state to: FAILED
children.next: Look at the same job's crawl/scan logs: was it stuck on blocked pages (S3) or idle?

children.title: Engine package failed to load on the worker
children.pattern: ENGINES_PLUGIN_ERROR … ENOENT / ENOTEMPTY / zlib
children.next: Evinced-side race on the worker; not the customer's page. New sub-issue candidate.

children.title: Result upload throttled
children.pattern: got error while trying to upload file to cloud … (GCS 429)
children.next: Harmless if a later write succeeds; signal only when the scan ends incomplete.

tree.title: The site did not serve the pages
tree.desc: Pages came back with an error status, a network error, or never finished loading.

children.title: The site answered with an error status
children.desc: 'http status code is: N' — logged at INFO, so error-level filters miss it. Look at the share per job/host.

children.title: Mostly 403 / 405
children.pattern: http status code is: 403|405 on most URLs of the job (often 1 page visited)
children.next: Blocked. Check: is static IP on for the property? Is a custom header set (extraHeaders)? Which user agent is sent (config dump)?

children.title: Many 429
children.pattern: http status code is: 429 across many URLs
children.next: Rate limited: move to speed-tier slow, check sibling properties scheduled at the same time.

children.title: 202 bursts
children.pattern: http status code is: 202 on many URLs
children.next: Likely a bot-manager 'please wait' interstitial (unconfirmed).

children.title: 401 on pages after login
children.pattern: http status code is: 401 / browser 401 errors after a successful login step
children.next: Session lost: check parallelism and whether logout URLs are crawled.

children.title: Many 404 / redirect to an error page
children.pattern: http status code is: 404, or final url … /404 /500
children.next: Seed or listed URLs are dead or redirect to an error page.

children.title: Network-level error on the page itself
children.desc: 'got error while scraping net::ERR_…' (not the [browser] sub-resource lines, which are background noise).

children.title: Connection reset / refused
children.pattern: net::ERR_CONNECTION_RESET | ERR_CONNECTION_REFUSED at <url>
children.next: Firewall dropping scanner traffic; allowlist the static IPs.

children.title: Redirect loop
children.pattern: net::ERR_TOO_MANY_REDIRECTS
children.next: Customer-side redirect rule (often staging/auth gateways).

children.title: Host does not resolve
children.pattern: failed due to DNS_ERROR_COULD_NOT_FIND_URL
children.next: Internal or mistyped host in the seed list.

children.title: Pages never finished loading
children.desc: 'all attempts to scrape url had failed' with type OPEN_PAGE_TIMEOUT (one line per failed URL).

children.title: Almost every URL of the host times out
children.pattern: OPEN_PAGE_TIMEOUT on most URLs of one job
children.next: Behaves like a tarpit/block: treat as S3.1a — check static IP and allowlisting.

children.title: A few heavy URLs time out
children.pattern: OPEN_PAGE_TIMEOUT or gotoURL > 40000/60000 ms on a handful of URLs
children.next: Exclude those URLs or raise timeouts. gotoURL lines are per attempt (~2.8/URL) — don't count them as failures.

children.title: The browser landed somewhere unexpected
children.desc: 'final url after redirections' or the interaction error url is another country/site page.

children.title: Geo redirect
children.pattern: final url / error.url contains out-of-country (or a different country site)
children.next: Geo-blocking of US egress; customer must allowlist.

tree.title: The scanner could not log in or stay logged in
tree.desc: The property has a login; failures show in the page-interaction plugin.

children.title: A login element was not found
children.desc: 'No element found for selector: <sel>' with the url the browser was on.

children.title: Selector missing on the expected login page
children.pattern: No element found for selector … + error.url = the login page; PAGE_INTERACTION_PLUGIN_ERROR
children.next: First check the same job for 403/405 (S3.1a) — a blocked login page also 'loses' the selector. Otherwise update the selector.

children.title: Selector missing because the browser is on an MFA page
children.pattern: No element found … + error.url / final url matches mfa|otp|challenge
children.next: MFA cannot be automated: test user without MFA or IP-based bypass.

children.title: Invalid selector syntax
children.pattern: '<sel>' is not a valid selector
children.next: Fix the selector syntax in the login config.

children.title: The login step ran too long
children.desc: 'bound handleRequest execution took more than 300000 ms'.

children.title: Multi-step login hit the hard cap
children.pattern: Function: bound handleRequest execution took more than 300000 milliseconds
children.next: Needs a backend Multiple Interactions script, or longer waits per step.

children.title: Pages bounce back to the login page
children.desc: Visited pages' final URL is /login, /guest, /authenticate after login succeeded.

children.title: Session dropped mid-crawl
children.pattern: final url after redirections: …/login|guest|authenticate (high share in one job)
children.next: Logs can't tell expired password (B3) from session loss (B5): ask whether the password changed; else parallelism=1 and exclude logout URLs.

tree.title: The crawl kept the wrong set of URLs
tree.desc: Pages loaded fine, but the crawl ended with too few, too many, or the wrong URLs.

children.title: URLs were rejected by the scope rules
children.desc: 'not including url in result url set. reason: …' — most reasons are normal bookkeeping.

children.title: Seed rejected: final URL outside the whitelist
children.pattern: reason: final url not included in whitelist — on the seed or on every URL of the job
children.next: Seed redirects to another host/path: add it to the whitelist or use the final URL as seed.

children.title: Every URL rejected by the language filter
children.pattern: reason: language is not included in whitelist — on every URL
children.next: Locale filter doesn't match the site's language tags.

children.title: Content type rejected (case bug)
children.pattern: content type text/HTML; charset=utf-8 is not allowed
children.next: Likely a case-sensitivity bug in the content-type check — escalate.

children.title: The crawl ended almost empty
children.desc: The highest 'successfully visited N pages so far' for the job is 0–1.

children.title: 1 page and nothing filtered out
children.pattern: max visited ≤ 1 and 'filtered out: 0 urls', no errors
children.next: Either the page has no real links (JS navigation → List mode) or it is a challenge/block page served as 200.

children.title: 1 page with blocks or rejections
children.pattern: max visited ≤ 1 plus S3.1a or S5.1a lines in the same job
children.next: Follow the branch the companion lines point to.

children.title: The crawl hit a configured cap
children.desc: 'matching grouping … is full' / 'max number of successful visits was reached' — background, by design.

children.title: Page or grouping cap reached
children.pattern: not handling request … reason: max number of successful visits was reached | matching grouping … is full
children.next: Explains 'fewer pages than expected': raise maxPagesCount or loosen grouping rules.

children.title: The property configuration itself is the clue
children.desc: The crawler logs its full config once per job ('crawler config is: {…}').

children.title: Old user agent / no custom header / wrong scope
children.pattern: config is: { … --user-agent=…Chrome/65 … extraHeaders: null … whitelist … }
children.next: Context, not an error. Contains credentials — read only the fields you need, never paste it into a ticket.

tree.title: Pages loaded but the analysis failed
tree.desc: The page opened, but the accessibility engines or plugins errored.

children.title: The engine crashed on the page
children.desc: 'failed due to FAILED_TO_RUN_ENGINES' with a stack trace.

children.title: Engine error on specific DOMs
children.pattern: {"type":"FAILED_TO_RUN_ENGINES", … stackTrace …}
children.next: Exclude the page as a workaround; open an engine bug with the URL and stack trace.

children.title: A plugin step hung
children.desc: PLUGIN_TIMEOUT / 'bound run execution took more than'.

children.title: Plugin timeout on heavy pages
children.pattern: failed due to PLUGIN_TIMEOUT | Function: bound run execution took more than N ms
children.next: Heavy page; same handling as S3.3b.

children.title: The page changed while being analysed
children.desc: 'Execution context was destroyed' / 'frame was detached'.

children.title: Navigation during analysis
children.pattern: Execution context was destroyed, most likely because of a navigation
children.next: Pop-ups or late redirects; findings may vary between runs.

tree.title: Problems after the scan
tree.desc: The scan finished, but results, exports, emails or the UI fail.

children.title: The UI is slow or errors ('Error loading scan')
children.desc: Controller calls logged with durations; failures with the request URI.

children.title: Slow API call
children.pattern: invocation of function (<Controller>.<method>) took N millis (WARNING > ~10 s)
children.next: Heavy View / huge property; simplify the View.

children.title: API call failed
children.pattern: invocation of function (…) failed (<Exception>: …) — NotFound (deleted scan/view), NPE, 5xx
children.next: NotFound = deleted object or stale link; other exceptions = product bug.

children.title: Export or email not delivered
children.desc: Export poller and email sender log their failures.

children.title: Export generation failed
children.pattern: failed to generate CSV|XLSX for scan … (poller timeout | poll request failed) / publish to queue …-csv failed
children.next: Scan deleted or queue down; note the onFailed() bug hides the failure from the user.

children.title: Completion email failed
children.pattern: Failed to send (crawl|scan) completion email for …
children.next: Property deleted or SendGrid unavailable.

children.title: Integration or MCP errors
children.desc: Only MCP leaves a trace in these services.

children.title: MCP caller rejected
children.pattern: An invalid request caller ID was received: MCP
children.next: Jira/ADO calls are not logged here at all.

tree.title: No trace in the logs
tree.desc: These problems are real but leave no distinctive log line today; diagnose them another way.

children.title: Looks normal in the logs
children.desc: Status 200, no errors — the problem is in the page content or the UI.

children.title: Soft block (block page with 200)
children.pattern: nothing: page title / DOM size are not logged
children.next: Look at the scan's screenshots / issue spike on landmark & H1 rules.

children.title: Static IP not used
children.pattern: nothing: the egress IP is not logged
children.next: Check the property's use-static-ip flag in Retool.

children.title: TLS certificate error
children.pattern: nothing: the browser ignores certificate errors
children.next: Open the site in a browser and check the certificate.

children.title: Grouping merges or splits pages
children.pattern: nothing beyond page counts
children.next: Review grouping rules against the URL list.

children.title: UI, export semantics, findings, account questions
children.pattern: nothing in server logs
children.next: Handle from the product and the ticket text.

signatures.message_pattern: all attempts to scrape url had failed
signatures.dataprime: source logs | filter $l.applicationname == 'site-scanner' && ($l.subsystemname == 'crawl-worker' || $l.subsystemname == 'scan-worker') && $d.message == 'all attempts to scrape url had failed' | extract $d.error.message:string into $d.ej using jsonobject() | extract $d.context.url:string into $d.u using regexp(e=/https?:\/\/(?<host>[^\/:?#]+)/) | groupby $l.subsystemname, $d.u.host:string as host, $d.ej.type:string as etype aggregate count() as n | orderby n desc
signatures.volume: 2026-11-02 24h: crawl 5,488, scan 59. Types: OPEN_PAGE_TIMEOUT 5,502; FAILED_TO_RUN_ENGINES 20; DNS_ERROR_COULD_NOT_FIND_URL 13; INTERNAL_ERROR 10; PAGE_INTERACTION_PLUGIN_ERROR 4
signatures.noise: This is the one record per URL that really failed (not a retry). Volume is dominated by a few hosts (www.aa.com 82% of OPEN_PAGE_TIMEOUT). Signal = failure share for the ticket's property/host.
signatures.notes: Route by .type: OPEN_PAGE_TIMEOUT -> D1 if few URLs on a healthy host, A1/A2 if most of the host fails; FAILED_TO_RUN_ENGINES -> D2; DNS_ERROR_COULD_NOT_FIND_URL -> C4 (bad host); PAGE_INTERACTION_PLUGIN_ERROR -> B2/B4; INTERNAL_ERROR -> product bug.

signatures.message_pattern: all attempts to scrape url had failed + $d.error.message {"type":"OPEN_PAGE_TIMEOUT"}
signatures.dataprime: source logs | filter $l.applicationname == 'site-scanner' && ($l.subsystemname == 'crawl-worker' || $l.subsystemname == 'scan-worker') && $d.message == 'all attempts to scrape url had failed' && $d.error.message:string ~ 'OPEN_PAGE_TIMEOUT' | extract $d.context.url:string into $d.u using regexp(e=/https?:\/\/(?<host>[^\/:?#]+)/) | groupby $d.u.host:string as host aggregate count() as n
signatures.noise: Chronic background on a few big sites. Signal when the ticket's host is >~20% of its URLs, or new compared with earlier runs.
signatures.notes: Disambiguate with http status lines (403/429 -> A1/A5), host-wide vs few URLs (A vs D1), and the page title/'Just a moment'.

signatures.message_pattern: encountered error while running a function with timeout. retry count: N + $d.error.message errorDescription 'Error. Function: gotoURL execution took more than (60000|40000) miliseconds'
signatures.dataprime: source logs | filter $l.applicationname == 'site-scanner' && ($l.subsystemname == 'crawl-worker' || $l.subsystemname == 'scan-worker') && $d.message ~ 'encountered error while running a function with timeout' | extract $d.error.message:string into $d.ej using jsonobject() | groupby $l.subsystemname, $d.ej.errorDescription:string as d aggregate count() as n, approx_count_distinct($d.context.request_id) as urls
signatures.volume: 2026-11-02 24h: crawl gotoURL>60000 17,263 attempts / 6,126 URLs; scan gotoURL>40000 157 / 104 URLs
signatures.noise: Per-ATTEMPT record (~2.8 per URL). Do not count it as failures; a URL that recovers on retry emits this but no all-attempts record. Use all-attempts for failures.
signatures.notes: Zendesk 'gotoURL ... 40000' is the scan-worker limit; crawl uses 60000.

signatures.message_pattern: encountered error while running a function with timeout + errorDescription 'Function: bound run execution took more than (20000|30000|60000|90000|120000) miliseconds'
signatures.dataprime: source logs | filter $l.applicationname == 'site-scanner' && $l.subsystemname == 'scan-worker' && $d.message ~ 'encountered error while running a function with timeout' && $d.error.message:string ~ 'bound run execution' | extract $d.error.message:string into $d.ej using jsonobject() | groupby $d.ej.errorDescription:string aggregate count() as n
signatures.noise: Rare; each one is a real page whose engine/plugin step hung
signatures.notes: Timeout value names the plugin step (20 s and 30 s are probably interaction/stabilise, 90/120 s the engines). Pair with 'got error while running plugin'.

signatures.message_pattern: errorDescription 'Function: bound handleRequest execution took more than 300000 miliseconds'
signatures.dataprime: source logs | filter $l.applicationname == 'site-scanner' && ($l.subsystemname == 'scan-worker' || $l.subsystemname == 'crawl-worker') && $d.error.message:string ~ 'bound handleRequest execution took more than'
signatures.noise: Rare, always signal
signatures.notes: 5-minute whole-page cap; on a login URL it points to a multi-step login (B4).

signatures.message_pattern: http status code is: <N>  (Info severity)
signatures.dataprime: source logs | filter $l.applicationname == 'site-scanner' && ($l.subsystemname == 'crawl-worker' || $l.subsystemname == 'scan-worker') && $d.message ~ 'http status code is: ' | extract $d.message:string into $d.x using regexp(e=/status code is: (?<code>[0-9]+)/) | extract $d.context.url:string into $d.u using regexp(e=/https?:\/\/(?<host>[^\/:?#]+)/) | groupby $d.u.host:string as host, $d.x.code:string as code aggregate count() as n | orderby n desc
signatures.noise: Info level, the page is NOT failed: the error/block page is scanned. Scattered 404s are normal; the signal is a high non-200 ratio for one host.
signatures.notes: 403/405 -> A1; 429 -> A5; 404 on seeds -> C4; 401 -> B5; 5xx on customer host -> customer outage (C4-ish). Filter with != '200' on the extracted code (character classes inside ~ did not match).

signatures.message_pattern: [browser] [error] Failed to load resource: net::ERR_<X>
signatures.dataprime: source logs | filter $l.applicationname == 'site-scanner' && ($l.subsystemname == 'crawl-worker' || $l.subsystemname == 'scan-worker') && $d.message ~ 'Failed to load resource: net::ERR_' | extract $d.message:string into $d.x using regexp(e=/(?<code>net::ERR_[A-Z0-9_]+)/) | groupby $l.subsystemname, $d.x.code:string aggregate count() as n
signatures.noise: BENIGN background: page sub-resources (trackers, blocked third parties). Ignore unless ERR_HTTP2_SERVER_REFUSED_STREAM / ERR_CERT_* or nearly every request for one host fails.
signatures.notes: ERR_HTTP2_SERVER_REFUSED_STREAM -> A5; not seen in this window.

signatures.message_pattern: encountered error while running a function with timeout + $d.error.message {"url":"<page url>","message":"No element found for selector: <sel>"}
signatures.dataprime: source logs | filter $l.applicationname == 'site-scanner' && ($m.templateid == '9b5233c6-9b48-11f1-bb8a-4206745c74cb' || $m.templateid == '3f414be4-9c6f-11f1-a76b-3e8752cb6a06' || $m.templateid == '23a24bcc-b0f1-11f1-8b5b-aedcf7151837') && $d.error.message:string ~ 'No element found for selector' | extract $d.error.message:string into $d.ej using jsonobject() | groupby $l.subsystemname, $d.ej.message:string as msg, $d.ej.url:string as final_url aggregate count() as n, approx_count_distinct($d.context.url) as urls | orderby n desc
signatures.noise: Always signal for the property. The final-type rollup is PAGE_INTERACTION_PLUGIN_ERROR (509 on 10-28).
signatures.notes: url=about:blank or same page -> B2 selector mismatch; url=/login|/guest|SSO host mid-crawl -> B5 session lost or B4 flow; url=out-of-country page -> A7.

signatures.message_pattern: $d.error.message {"url":"https://.../(login|guest|authenticate|out-of-country)...","message":...}
signatures.dataprime: source logs | filter $l.applicationname == 'site-scanner' && ($m.templateid == '9b5233c6-9b48-11f1-bb8a-4206745c74cb' || $m.templateid == '3f414be4-9c6f-11f1-a76b-3e8752cb6a06' || $m.templateid == '23a24bcc-b0f1-11f1-8b5b-aedcf7151837') && $d.error.message:string ~ '"url":' | extract $d.error.message:string into $d.ej using jsonobject() | filter $d.ej.url:string ~ 'login' || $d.ej.url:string ~ 'guest' || $d.ej.url:string ~ 'authenti' || $d.ej.url:string ~ 'out-of-country' | groupby $d.ej.url:string aggregate count() as n, any_value($d.context.url) as page
signatures.noise: signal
signatures.notes: Mid-crawl redirect to login/guest = session lost (B5) or bad credentials (B3); out-of-country = geo block A7.

signatures.message_pattern: {"type":"FAILED_TO_RUN_ENGINES","additionalInfo":{"stackTrace":"TypeError: Cannot read properties of (undefined|null) (reading ...)"}}
signatures.dataprime: source logs | filter $l.applicationname == 'site-scanner' && $l.subsystemname == 'scan-worker' && $d.error.message:string ~ 'FAILED_TO_RUN_ENGINES' | extract $d.error.message:string into $d.ej using jsonobject() | extract $d.context.url:string into $d.u using regexp(e=/https?:\/\/(?<host>[^\/:?#]+)/) | groupby $d.u.host:string as host, substr($d.ej.additionalInfo.stackTrace:string,0,80) as st aggregate count() as n
signatures.noise: Signal, low volume
signatures.notes: The stackTrace tells which engine/DOM property broke ('checked', 'value').

signatures.message_pattern: {"type":"ENGINES_PLUGIN_ERROR","additionalInfo":{"details":"Error: ENOENT|ENOTEMPTY ... | ZlibError | SyntaxError: Unexpected end of input"}}
signatures.dataprime: source logs | filter $l.applicationname == 'site-scanner' && $l.subsystemname == 'scan-worker' && $d.error.message:string ~ 'ENGINES_PLUGIN_ERROR' | extract $d.error.message:string into $d.ej using jsonobject() | groupby substr($d.ej.additionalInfo.details:string,0,60) as d aggregate count() as n, any_value($d.context.url) as url
signatures.noise: Not caused by the customer page: engine bundle download/extract race on the worker filesystem.
signatures.notes: Candidate new sub-issue: 'engine package load failure on worker' (Evinced-side). Looks like D2 to the customer (pages missing).

signatures.message_pattern: final .type in PLUGIN_TIMEOUT | INTERNAL_ERROR | DNS_ERROR_COULD_NOT_FIND_URL | SCREENSHOT_PLUGIN_ERROR | LINK_EXTRACTION_PLUGIN_ERROR
signatures.dataprime: source logs | filter $l.applicationname == 'site-scanner' && ($m.templateid == '9b5222f0-9b48-11f1-bb8a-4206745c74cb' || $m.templateid == '0d569b2a-9b5c-11f1-a137-c2fc7991ad86') | extract $d.error.message:string into $d.ej using jsonobject() | groupby formatTimestamp($m.timestamp, '%Y-%m-%d') as day, $d.ej.type:string as etype aggregate count() as n
signatures.volume: 7d: PLUGIN_TIMEOUT 420 (tsn.ca, noovo.info), INTERNAL_ERROR 180, DNS_ERROR 44 final (132 per-attempt; capitalone, smartpaylease int host)
signatures.noise: low volume, signal
signatures.notes: DNS_ERROR -> C4 (host does not resolve publicly, e.g. internal QA hosts -> needs a private agent / wrong seed). INTERNAL_ERROR (Scraper.ts:139) -> product bug. PLUGIN_TIMEOUT -> D1.

signatures.message_pattern: got error while scraping net::ERR_(CONNECTION_REFUSED|CONNECTION_RESET|TOO_MANY_REDIRECTS|HTTP2_PROTOCOL_ERROR) at <url>  (also as plain text in $d.error.message)
signatures.dataprime: source logs | filter $l.applicationname == 'site-scanner' && ($m.templateid == '9b5233c6-9b48-11f1-bb8a-4206745c74cb' || $m.templateid == '3f414be4-9c6f-11f1-a76b-3e8752cb6a06' || $m.templateid == '23a24bcc-b0f1-11f1-8b5b-aedcf7151837') && $d.error.message:string ~ 'net::ERR_' | extract $d.error.message:string into $d.x using regexp(e=/(?<code>net::ERR_[A-Z0-9_]+) at https?:\/\/(?<host>[^\/:?#]+)/) | groupby $d.x.code:string, $d.x.host:string aggregate count() as n
signatures.volume: 7d: ERR_CONNECTION_RESET telebec.com ~390; ERR_TOO_MANY_REDIRECTS moo.com/denverbariatrics ~40; ERR_HTTP2_PROTOCOL_ERROR discover.com 18; ERR_CONNECTION_REFUSED HCA hospital sites ~8/day
signatures.noise: Signal (it is the page itself, unlike the [browser] lines)
signatures.notes: RESET/HTTP2_PROTOCOL host-wide -> A1 WAF; TOO_MANY_REDIRECTS -> A8; CONNECTION_REFUSED -> host down / C4. No ERR_CERT_* seen (A9).

signatures.message_pattern: Execution context was destroyed, most likely because of a navigation | Navigating frame was detached | Attempted to use detached Frame
signatures.dataprime: source logs | filter $l.applicationname == 'site-scanner' && ($m.templateid == '9b5233c6-9b48-11f1-bb8a-4206745c74cb' || $m.templateid == '3f414be4-9c6f-11f1-a76b-3e8752cb6a06' || $m.templateid == '23a24bcc-b0f1-11f1-8b5b-aedcf7151837') && ($d.error.message:string ~ 'Execution context was destroyed' || $d.error.message:string ~ 'detached') | groupby $d.context.url aggregate count() as n
signatures.noise: Signal for that page, low volume
signatures.notes: The page navigates or reloads itself (redirect script, consent reload, bot challenge reload).

signatures.message_pattern: scan page <url> failed, scan id is <scanId>. last successful result file prod-mon/tasks/<scanId>/results/joiner-results/<id>.json
signatures.dataprime: source logs | filter $l.applicationname == 'site-scanner' && $l.subsystemname == 'scrape-server' && $d.message ~ ' failed, scan id is ' | extract $d.message:string into $d.x using regexp(e=/scan page (?<url>[^ ]+) failed, scan id is (?<sid>[0-9a-f-]+)/) | groupby $d.x.sid:string aggregate count() as pages, any_value($d.x.url) as sample
key_fields: url and scanId in the message
signatures.noise: Roll-up with no reason; documents (pdf/zip) are expected. Use it to list a scan's dropped pages, then join to scan-worker by URL for the reason.

signatures.message_pattern: content type: <ct> doesn't match the: text/html,text/plain
signatures.dataprime: source logs | filter $l.applicationname == 'site-scanner' && ($m.templateid == 'a92c1eca-a74c-11f1-9144-fab0241da207' || $m.templateid == 'e7b5fc88-aaf8-11f1-b655-422d8edb1526') | extract $d.message:string into $d.x using regexp(e=/content type: (?<ct>[^ ]+) /) | groupby $d.x.ct:string aggregate count() as n
signatures.noise: BENIGN: non-HTML links are skipped by design
signatures.notes: Relevant only if a customer asks why PDFs aren't scanned, or the seed itself is a document.

signatures.message_pattern: got error while trying to upload file to cloud. retry count: N, local path: ..., bucket: prod-mon-production, bucket path: prod-mon/tasks/<scanId>/results/crawl.json | error uploading file to bucket
signatures.dataprime: source logs | filter $l.applicationname == 'site-scanner' && $l.subsystemname == 'scan-worker' && ($d.message ~ 'upload file to cloud' || $d.message ~ 'error uploading file to bucket') | extract $d.message:string into $d.x using regexp(e=/tasks\/(?<sid>[0-9a-f-]+)\//) | groupby $d.x.sid:string, substr($d.error.message:string,0,60) as e aggregate count() as n
signatures.noise: Evinced-side; usually harmless if a later write succeeds. Signal if the same scan ends FAILED/incomplete.
signatures.notes: GCS per-object mutation rate limit: crawl.json rewritten too often on big scans.

signatures.message_pattern: not handling request after reading it from the queue. reason: matching grouping <regex> is full | max number of successful visits was reached
signatures.dataprime: source logs | filter $l.applicationname == 'site-scanner' && $m.templateid == '08e4a5d0-9b45-11f1-a536-52ef7929d954' | groupby $d.context.url aggregate count() as n
signatures.noise: BENIGN: the configured page/grouping cap working as intended
signatures.notes: Relevant only for 'why did the crawl stop at N pages' (grouping limits, C5).

signatures.message_pattern: http status code is: <NNN>  (main-document status of each visited page; Info)
signatures.dataprime: source logs | filter $l.applicationname == 'site-scanner' && $d.resource.attributes.environment == 'production' && $d.message ~ 'http status code is: ' && !($d.message ~ 'is: 200') | groupby $l.subsystemname, $d.resource.attributes['k8s.job.name'] as job, $d.message aggregate count() as n, any_value($d.context.url) as url | orderby n desc
signatures.noise: Sporadic 404/403 are normal. Signal = share of non-200 within one job: a job where most visits are 403/405 => A1, many 429 => A5; 202 often = bot-manager interstitial (Akamai/Cloudflare 'please wait') => A2. 30x rarely appear here because redirects are followed (see final_url line).
signatures.notes: Primary access signal. 403/405 -> A1, 429 -> A5, 202 -> A2 candidate, 401 -> B5/B3, 404 on seed -> C4. Join with job id to see whether it hits all pages.

signatures.message_pattern: [browser] [error] Failed to load resource: the server responded with a status of <NNN> (<text>)
signatures.dataprime: source logs | filter $l.applicationname == 'site-scanner' && $d.resource.attributes.environment == 'production' && $d.message ~ 'Failed to load resource: the server responded with a status of' | extract $d.message into $d.sc using regexp(e=/status of (?<code>[0-9]{3})/) | groupby $l.subsystemname, $d.sc.code aggregate count() as n, approx_count_distinct($d.resource.attributes['k8s.job.name']) as jobs
signatures.noise: Mostly sub-resource (JS/XHR/images) failures — noisy; NOT the page status. Template f8cca772 is shared with any [browser] [error] console line.
signatures.notes: Only meaningful when it coincides with a non-200 'http status code is' for the document, or as a burst of 401 after login (B5).

signatures.message_pattern: not including url in result url set. reason: final url not included in whitelist
signatures.dataprime: source logs | filter $l.applicationname == 'site-scanner' && $d.resource.attributes.environment == 'production' && $l.subsystemname == 'crawl-worker' && $d.message ~ 'final url not included in whitelist' | groupby $d.resource.attributes['k8s.job.name'] as job aggregate count() as n, any_value($d.context.url) as url | orderby n desc
key_fields: $d.context.url (the requested URL, final URL not printed)
signatures.noise: Normal for external links when whitelist is the site domain. Signal = the SEED URL (or every URL of the job) rejected => 0-page crawl.
signatures.notes: Message does not show the final URL; pair with 'finished waiting for page to stabilize. final url after redirections' / 'successfully scraped url. final url:' for the same request_id, and the whitelist from scan-worker 'crawler config is:'.

signatures.message_pattern: not including url in result url set. reason: (final url is included in blacklist|final url was already visited. this is most likely due to a redirection|sanitized url was already visited|content type <x> is not allowed|max number of successful visits was reached|language is not included in whitelist|matching grouping rule <re> is full})
signatures.dataprime: source logs | filter $l.applicationname == 'site-scanner' && $d.message ~ 'not including url in result url set' | extract $d.message into $d.rx using regexp(e=/reason: (?<reason>[a-zA-Z _.:-]{0,60})/) | groupby $l.subsystemname, $d.rx.reason aggregate count() as n | orderby n desc
signatures.volume: 7d: blacklist 129,745; already visited via redirect 57,791; sanitized dup 17,843; content-type ~20.6k; max visits 2,279; language 1,119; grouping full ~1.9k; text/HTML case 110
signatures.noise: Mostly benign bookkeeping. Signals: 'language is not included in whitelist' on every URL of a job (C1 locale filter); 'final url was already visited ... redirection' burst (many URLs redirect to the same login/error/geo page => B5/C4/A7); 'content type text/HTML; charset=utf-8 is not allowed' (case-sensitive content-type bug => site loses all pages).
signatures.notes: Reason 'final url is included in ...' is truncated in the log line itself (blacklist).

signatures.message_pattern: (CRAWL|SCAN) with id <id> failed due to <REASON> - <json>
signatures.dataprime: source logs | filter $l.applicationname == 'site-scanner' && $d.message ~ 'failed due to' | extract $d.message into $d.fr using regexp(e=/(?<kind>[A-Z]+) with id \S+ failed due to (?<reason>[A-Z_0-9]+)/) | groupby $l.subsystemname, $d.fr.kind, $d.fr.reason aggregate count() as n, approx_count_distinct($d.resource.attributes['k8s.job.name']) as jobs | orderby n desc
signatures.volume: 7d: CRAWL OPEN_PAGE_TIMEOUT 30,788 (60 jobs); SCAN OPEN_PAGE_TIMEOUT 13,545 (34); CRAWL 'undefined' 4,435 (8); SCAN PAGE_INTERACTION_PLUGIN_ERROR 560 (6); SCAN PLUGIN_TIMEOUT 421; SCAN FAILED_TO_RUN_ENGINES 201; CRAWL INTERNAL_ERROR 170; DNS_ERROR_COULD_NOT_FIND_URL 25 crawl/24 scan; CRAWL PAGE_INTERACTION_PLUGIN_ERROR 18
signatures.noise: One line per failed URL (Info severity!). OPEN_PAGE_TIMEOUT on nearly all URLs of a job => block/tarpit (A1/A5) or down site; scattered => slow pages.
signatures.notes: The enum has no HTTP/WAF-specific value (no BLOCKED/HTTP_403) — blocks surface as OPEN_PAGE_TIMEOUT or as successful pages with 403 status. PAGE_INTERACTION_PLUGIN_ERROR carries 'No element found for selector: <sel>' and the url the browser was on (B2; if url is an unexpected page => A7/B1/B4). DNS_ERROR_COULD_NOT_FIND_URL => C4.

signatures.message_pattern: crawler config is: {... "whitelist":[..],"languageWhitelist":[..],"scraperConfig":{"puppeteerArgs":[.."--user-agent=<UA>"],"extraHeaders":<null|{..}>, ...}, "pubsubMessageMetadata":{..tenancyName, propertyName, scanId..}}

signatures.notes: UA 'HeadlessChrome/65...' or 'Chrome/65...' => A6 risk (~25% of pages in 7d). extraHeaders non-null => custom header configured. whitelist/languageWhitelist regexes to test against seed/final URL for C1/C2. parallelNum>1 with login => B5 risk. Never copy extraHeaders values or interaction credentials from this line.

signatures.message_pattern: browser was opened successfully. version: Chrome/<ver>
signatures.dataprime: source logs | filter $l.applicationname == 'site-scanner' && $d.resource.attributes.environment == 'production' && $m.templateid == 'd1d6dbd8-9c4f-11f1-8905-329537c5ee79' | groupby $d.message aggregate count() as n, approx_count_distinct($d.resource.attributes['k8s.job.name']) as jobs
signatures.volume: 340k/7d (one per page open), single value Chrome/126.0.6478.126
signatures.noise: Pure background; constant across fleet.
signatures.notes: Shows the engine, not the UA header sent. A6 must be judged from the --user-agent in the config dump.

signatures.message_pattern: finished waiting for page to stabilize. final url after redirections: <url> | successfully scraped url. final url: <url> | current page url: <url>
signatures.dataprime: source logs | filter $l.applicationname == 'site-scanner' && $d.resource.attributes.environment == 'production' && $d.message ~ 'final url after redirections' | extract $d.message into $d.fu using regexp(e=/redirections: (?<u>\S+)/) | create landing from if($d.fu.u:string.matches(/(?i)\/(u\/)?(login|signin|sign-in|logon|authenticate|sso|mfa|otp|challenge)|out-of-country|\/404|\/500|not-found|error/), 'login/error/geo', 'normal') | groupby $d.resource.attributes['k8s.job.name'] as job, landing aggregate count() as n, any_value($d.fu.u) as sample | orderby n desc

signatures.noise: Normal pages dominate. Signal = high share of landings on login/mfa/out-of-country/404/500 within one job, or seed final URL on another host.
signatures.notes: Path decides: /login after successful login => B5 (B3 if login never succeeded); /mfa|/otp => B1; out-of-country/geo => A7 (sky.de example); /404|/500 => C4; other host => C2.

signatures.message_pattern: got error while scraping No element found for selector: <sel> | element: <sel>, exists: false, in an iframe: <bool> | (CRAWL|SCAN) with id .. failed due to PAGE_INTERACTION_PLUGIN_ERROR - {.."message":"No element found for selector: <sel>"}
signatures.dataprime: source logs | filter $l.applicationname == 'site-scanner' && $d.resource.attributes.environment == 'production' && ($d.message ~ 'No element found for selector' || $d.message ~ 'exists: false') | groupby $l.subsystemname, $d.resource.attributes['k8s.job.name'] as job aggregate count() as n, any_value(substr($d.message:string,0,250)) as sample | orderby n desc
signatures.volume: 7d: 'got error while scraping No element found' 1,683 scan (4 jobs) + 97 crawl (8 jobs); PAGE_INTERACTION_PLUGIN_ERROR 560 scan + 18 crawl
signatures.noise: Always a real failure of a configured interaction; repeats per page in scan (each page re-logs-in?).
signatures.notes: If error.url is the expected login page => B2 (selector drift). If error.url is an unexpected page (out-of-country, /authenticate SSO hop, MFA) => A7/B4/B1. 'in an iframe: true' hints at modal/SSO (B4).

signatures.message_pattern: starting page interaction plugin | typing text in element: <sel> | clicking element: <sel>
signatures.dataprime: source logs | filter $l.applicationname == 'site-scanner' && $d.resource.attributes.environment == 'production' && ($d.message ~ 'typing text in element' || $d.message ~ 'clicking element' || $d.message ~ 'starting page interaction plugin') | groupby $l.subsystemname, $d.resource.attributes['k8s.job.name'] as job, $d.message aggregate count() as n | orderby job
signatures.noise: Background for authenticated properties; use as the trace of which step ran last before a failure.
signatures.notes: Typed values are not logged (good). Config dumps (TYPE_TEXT/CLICK_ELEMENT, loginConfiguration) may contain credentials: never copy. No 'bound handleRequest execution took more than 300000' seen in sample day.

signatures.message_pattern: got error while scraping net::ERR_<X> at <url>
signatures.dataprime: source logs | filter $l.applicationname == 'site-scanner' && $d.resource.attributes.environment == 'production' && $d.message ~ 'got error while scraping net::' | extract $d.message into $d.e using regexp(e=/(?<err>net::[A-Z_0-9]+)/) | groupby $l.subsystemname, $d.e.err, $d.resource.attributes['k8s.job.name'] as job aggregate count() as n, any_value($d.context.url) as url | orderby n desc
signatures.noise: Low volume, each is meaningful when concentrated in one job/host.
signatures.notes: ERR_TOO_MANY_REDIRECTS => A8; ERR_CONNECTION_RESET/REFUSED concentrated on one host => A1 (WAF/IP deny); ERR_HTTP2_PROTOCOL_ERROR => A1/A5. Most 'got error while scraping' lines (~123k/7d) have no detail — those are timeouts, see page_failed_due_to_reason.

signatures.message_pattern: successfully visited <N> pages so far
signatures.dataprime: source logs | filter $l.applicationname == 'site-scanner' && $d.resource.attributes.environment == 'production' && $m.templateid == '1212cbf6-9fa9-11f1-94dc-5ee20c2e67e1' | extract $d.message into $d.v using regexp(e=/visited (?<n>\d+) pages/) | groupby $d.resource.attributes['k8s.job.name'] as job aggregate max($d.v.n:number) as maxv | filter maxv <= 1
signatures.noise: Counter itself is benign; the per-job max is the signal.
signatures.notes: Finds 0/1-page crawls; then apply the decision recipe (status codes, whitelist reasons, interaction errors, 'filtered out: N urls'). Jobs that visit 0 pages may never print it — cross-check with scan-worker/scrape-server scanTotalUrls.

signatures.message_pattern: filtered out: <N> urls
signatures.dataprime: source logs | filter $l.applicationname == 'site-scanner' && $d.resource.attributes.environment == 'production' && $l.subsystemname == 'crawl-worker' && $d.message ~ 'filtered out: ' | groupby $d.resource.attributes['k8s.job.name'] as job aggregate count() as n, any_value($d.message) as sample
signatures.noise: benign per page
signatures.notes: 1-page crawl with 'filtered out: 0 urls' => no links found (C6 / challenge page); high N => links found but out of scope (C1/C2).

signatures.message_pattern: page <url> in scan <id> completed. <k> scan pages finished - waiting for <M> to be completed | METRIC_EVENT {.."eventType":"scan.page.complete",.."scanTotalUrls":"<M>"..}
signatures.dataprime: source logs | filter $l.applicationname == 'site-scanner' && $l.subsystemname == 'scrape-server' && $m.templateid == '81c746f6-aa4a-11f1-ba0a-6686f8ca4618' | extract $d.message into $d.s using regexp(e=/in scan (?<scan>\S+) completed\. \d+ scan pages finished - waiting for (?<m>\d+)/) | groupby $d.s.scan aggregate max($d.s.m:number) as total | filter total <= 1
signatures.noise: benign progress
signatures.notes: Gives scan size per scanId, linking a ticket's scan to a 1-page crawl.

signatures.message_pattern: (any line) $d.resource.attributes['k8s.node.name'] = gke-prod-mon-cluster-(crawls|scans)-pool-stat*
signatures.dataprime: source logs | filter $l.applicationname == 'site-scanner' && $d.resource.attributes.environment == 'production' && ($l.subsystemname == 'crawl-worker' || $l.subsystemname == 'scan-worker') | groupby $l.subsystemname, $d.resource.attributes['k8s.node.name'] as node aggregate approx_count_distinct($d.resource.attributes['k8s.job.name']) as jobs

signatures.notes: No egress IP is logged. A crawl that has no crawl-worker k8s job at all may have run on the fast tier (Cloud Function production_crawl_link_extractor — not present in Coralogix gcp/logs over 7d). Confirm A4 from Retool flags, not logs.

| Changed scan state from to (scrape-server)

signatures.message_pattern: failed to create entity for property with id: <propertyId>. continuing to the next property
signatures.dataprime: source logs | filter ($l.applicationname == 'admin' || $l.applicationname == 'front' || $l.subsystemname == 'admin-webapp' || $l.subsystemname == 'front-webapp') && $d.message ~ 'failed to create entity for property' | groupby $d.error.type, substr($d.error.message:string,0,120) as emsg aggregate count() as n, distinct_count($d.context.property_id) as props | orderby n desc

signatures.dataprime: source logs | filter ($l.subsystemname == 'front-server' || $l.subsystemname == 'front-webapp') && $d.logger_name == 'c.e.c.l.f.FunctionLogger' && ($d.message ~ 'ViewsController' || $d.message ~ 'ScanController' || $d.message ~ 'ScanPagesController' || $d.message ~ 'ScanIssuesController' || $d.message ~ 'PropertyOverview') | extract $d.message into $d.fx using regexp(e=/\((?<fn>[A-Za-z]+\.[A-Za-z]+)\) (?<what>took|failed)/) | extract $d.message into $d.fm using regexp(e=/(?<ms>[0-9]+) millis/) | groupby $d.fx.fn, $d.fx.what, $m.severity, $d.context.tenant_name aggregate count() as n, avg($d.fm.ms:number) as avgms, max($d.fm.ms:number) as mx | orderby mx desc
